verdict.rationale: Typesense documents a first-party hosted MCP server at cloud.typesense.org/mcp/v1. Through it an agent can create clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics, with user-scoped permissions and the ability to disconnect. That covers index operations and metrics, but running search queries is not explicitly listed and the server is documented only for Typesense Cloud. missing for 10: explicit documentation of query execution via MCP, search-analytics coverage beyond 'read metrics', an MCP/tool surface for self-hosted deployments, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can use my search indexes as a tool — an MCP server or tool-calling surface exposes query, analytics, and index operations

citations.quote: Connect your AI agent to Typesense Cloud and it can create and configure clusters, build collections, index your data, tune search and read metrics, all from the conversation.
claude mcp add --transport http typesense-cloud https://cloud.typesense.org/mcp/v1
You decide what it is allowed to do when you connect it, and you can disconnect it at any time.
